wounds.name: Apathy
wounds.description: Nothing feels worth the first step.

wounds.name: Grief
wounds.description: A loss froze their hands mid-motion.

wounds.name: Fear
wounds.description: Trying again feels like walking onto thin ice.

wounds.name: Exhaustion
wounds.description: The tank is empty; even hope sounds loud.

wounds.name: Disillusionment
wounds.description: They believed once. Someone sold that belief cheap.

wounds.name: Shame
wounds.description: They are the mistake they cannot stop rehearsing.
